retrieval_policy.current_attempt: No external retrieval was performed. Known links are recorded as leads, not as evidence that material is present or usable.
retrieval_policy.restricted_content: Do not bypass authentication, geographic controls, platform controls, robots restrictions, or licensing limits. Do not copy unavailable textbook or platform content into a learner view.
later_retrieval_requirements: Use only authorized retrieval mechanisms and publicly or lawfully accessible material.
Record the original record ID, requested URL, resolved URL, retrieval result, immutable identifier or checksum when possible, and license or access constraints.
Validate actual titles, boundaries, order, prerequisites, and content before promoting a record to a unit node.
Keep failed retrieval attempts and uncertainty explicit; never synthesize missing official prompts or transcripts.
Store examiner-only material outside student_safe and expose only learner-safe, licensed resources to learners.
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: A later job may expand the course only after deterministic ingestion and validation establish both material availability and an honest unit boundary.
